mechanical credit selects up to 20 feedback-open rows by session, uses session active episode effects from each retrieval timestamp through now, and does not require the completed round retrieval_id

new_architecture_conclusion: Frankenstein 2.0 must bind retrieval credit before evaluation, not only at reducer receipt time. Exact retrieval/turn/episode/causal/generation identity and exact assistant/effect/model evidence refs must travel together. Session-newest/open-row heuristics fail the causal-boundary requirement.
counterhypothesis: Strictly sequential per-session hook delivery may make the current heuristic operationally adequate in common steady-state runs; this is not source-enforced and fail-silent timeout/error paths can leave older rows open.
